title: Field Sales Executive - Hiring For PhonePe - Upto 5.5 LPA
description:
Company 
 Hiring for PhonePe, India's reputed fintech organisation. This position is on direct payroll of the oraganisation. 
 Job Objective 
 Sell EDC Machines / POS Machines among offline merchants in the assigned geographical area. The role involves merchant acquisition, device sales, merchant servicing and relationship management. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Identify and onboard new merchants in the assigned area. 
 Sell and install EDC/POS Machines at eligible merchant outlets. 
 Provide basic support to merchants and ensure smooth usage of the POS machine. 
 Support rental/other applicable collections and reactivate inactive merchants as required. 
 Maintain strong relationships with merchants and ensure customer satisfaction. 
 Identify new business opportunities and increase POS penetration in the assigned territory. 
 Track competitor activities and share relevant market information with the team. 
 Requirements 
 Minimum 6 months of B2B / field sales experience preferred. 
 Must have completed 12th exams 
 Good communication and interpersonal skills. 
 Comfortable with field sales and local market visits. 
 Two-wheeler and valid driving licence mandatory 
 
 
 Compensation 
 Maximum take home of Rs 34200 will be offered. 15 to 20% increase on last salary 
 PF, Gratuity, Insurance 
 Attractive incentives - Potential to earn 10,000 to 20,000 every month 
 Travel allowance 
 Phone allowance Call for scheduling interview
